compiled_state.title: Story B: linear-history cutover -- required_linear_history + merge-commit-class elimination (ADR-0020, deferred)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
As a maintainer, I want merge commits eliminated from the main-bound flow (rebase-not-merge end-to-end + GitHub required_linear_history on the main ruleset) so the merge-commit provenance-ambiguity class (4ba5 empty-diff, evil-merge, un-provenanced-merge) is removed BY CONSTRUCTION and the clean-merge exemption becomes dead code -- WITHOUT weakening the review guarantee.

## STATUS (updated 2026-06-05): DD1+DD3 LANDED on main; DD2+DD4 deferred to rollout (admin go-live)
DD1 (rebase-not-merge end-to-end) + DD3 (clean-merge exemption removal) landed on main@cded6d29d3 (v1.17.136) via the two-tier bootstrap (PR #663 -> staged, PR #664 -> main; force-merged-fp-recovery on PR #663 after an opus re-review cleared the non-converging review-sub-pr FPs). DD2 (required_linear_history ruleset flip) and DD4 (live-verify) are admin/go-live and are deferred to rollout — they ride the 3ee4 enforce-flip go-live and are tracked as rollout obligations.

## STATUS: DEFERRED / proof-gated
GO-rated by experiments L1-L8 (resilience-hardening-plan SS5/SS6.5, all CONFIRMED). ADR-0020-non-reversing (only the merge mechanic changes). Sequenced AFTER the cheap availability items, BEFORE story 7 (3ee4 enforce-flip).

## Done Definition
- DD1 [LANDED — main@cded6d29d3, v1.17.136]: enforce rebase-not-merge end-to-end in merge-to-main-pr.sh (PR1 and PR2). Implemented via gh pr merge --rebase at the PR1 and PR2 sites plus _publish_rebased_branch (explicit-lease force-publish, no lease-defeating fetch). Verify: _publish_rebased_branch and "--auto --rebase" present in plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh on origin/main; no --merge auto-merge sites remain.
- DD2 [DEFERRED TO ROLLOUT — admin go-live]: enable GitHub required_linear_history on the main ruleset (15629023) [admin] so merge commits cannot reach main. Provision via the throwaway lintest/** ruleset experiment pattern first; flip live at go-live. This is an admin ruleset flip deferred to rollout (rides the 3ee4 enforce-flip go-live); tracked as a rollout obligation.
- DD3 [LANDED — main@cded6d29d3]: retire the now-dead clean-merge exemption (_is_clean_merge / _vsp_is_clean_merge). Removed from review-coverage-invariant.sh and verify-session-provenance.sh (only a documenting comment remains on main); opus re-review confirmed no residual predicate/metric/output references.
- DD4 [DEFERRED TO ROLLOUT — needs DD2]: live-verify -- a rebased/linear PR2 lands; a merge-commit PR2 is rejected by the ruleset. Deferred to rollout (depends on DD2 live ruleset flip); tracked as a rollout obligation.

## Experiments (anchored here from the plan)
L1-L8 (SS6.5): the base-EXCLUDING coverage walk means rebased SHAs land in base and are never re-walked (L3 decisive); L8 = clean-merge exemption unreachable. Re-confirm on a throwaway lintest/** ruleset before the live flip.

## Dependencies
- blocks: 3ee4 (S7 enforce-flip -- linear history should land first).
- relates_to: the resilience-hardening story; 4ba5 (the merge-commit class this eliminates by construction).
- ADR: docs/adr/0020-two-tier-hardening-over-merge-queue.md.

comments.body: DD1 IMPLEMENTED (loop, 2026-06-05), TDD, regression-free. Rebase-not-merge end-to-end in merge-to-main-pr.sh: Site A (PR1 step-5 fallback ~1118) --merge->--rebase; Site C (_phase_queue_auto_merge ~1409) --auto --merge->--auto --rebase; Site E (PR2 poll-fallback ~2195) --merge->--rebase; Site D (KEYSTONE, pre-push default-branch sync ~1180) extracted into _sync_branch_against_default(), local 'git merge --no-edit origin/<default>' -> 'git rebase', sets _SYNCED_VIA_REBASE=1 so publish uses --force-with-lease (avoids replaying rewritten commits onto stale origin/<branch> and doubling them). This is what makes 'gh pr merge --rebase' viable (a merge commit in PR head makes GitHub's rebase-merge refuse the PR). Scope: STORY_PR_BASE/ci-pr path (inject_and_enable_automerge F/H/I ~2943/2972/2981) is a SEPARATE flow w/ DSO-Story-Merge merge-commit-trailer invariant, NOT 'PR1 and PR2' -> noted follow-up. prebump-sync (0f17) needs NO change (already rebases onto pinned main). Tests: NEW test-merge-to-main-linear-sync.sh 4/4 (D1 linear+0-merge-commits+flag, D2 up-to-date noop, D3 conflict abort-restore, D4 unrelated skip); updated t_pr_auto_merge_queued + t_auto_merge_disabled_invokes_manual_merge_in_poll assert --rebase + never --merge. Regression sweep clean (prebump 5/5, staged-intermediate 11/11, version-bump 22/22, locking 25/25, session-push 5/5). Pre-existing unrelated fails (fail on original script too): t_emit_local_escalation_includes_next_action, auto-resolve 9F, cleanliness 11F. REMAINING: DD3 pending user decision (delete vs demote-to-tripwire; safeguard files); DD2 required_linear_history ruleset 15629023 = admin/go-live (lintest/** first); DD4 live-verify needs DD2. L8 written proof NOT in-repo (construct + confirm on lintest/**).

comments.body:
DD2/DD4 MECHANISM VERIFIED LIVE (2026-06-05, lintest/** experiment, throwaway ruleset 17331119 = required_linear_history on refs/heads/lintest/**):
- TEST A (clean linear base, new branch) -> ACCEPTED.
- TEST B (linear update to existing ref) -> ACCEPTED.
- TEST C (merge-commit update to existing ref) -> REJECTED: 'This branch must not contain merge commits. Found 1 violation: bd7db091...'.
Confirms DD4 mechanism: required_linear_history accepts linear/rebased pushes and rejects merge commits. Go-live finding: on an EXISTING ref it evaluates only newly-added commits (Test B accepted, Test C rejected on the same ref) -> flipping it live on main will NOT retroactively reject main's existing merge history; it blocks only NEW merge commits. REMAINING for full DD2/DD4 (deferred to the 3ee4 go-live): (1) convert the inject_and_enable_automerge story->main path (merge-to-main-pr.sh ~3029/3058/3067, --auto --merge) and any other main-bound merge-commit paths to rebase/squash; (2) flip required_linear_history live on main ruleset 15629023; (3) re-run this accept/reject verification against the live main ruleset. cca8 stays OPEN until then.
